title: Public Alert No. 031/2025 – Alert on the Presence of an Unauthorized/ Unregistered Darzalex (Daratumumab) 1800mg/15ml vial SC Injection in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns that unauthorized/unregistered Darzalex (daratumumab) 1800mg/15ml SC injection vials are being sold in Nigeria. Packs meant for the Indian market (batch PKS1F01, exp 10-2026) and Arab market were not bought from Johnson & Johnson's official distributors.
